items.example: We took a trip to the mountains.
items.simple: You go to a place far from home and come back.

items.example: I am on holiday next week.
items.simple: Days when you do not go to work or school and you rest.

items.example: Don’t forget your passport.
items.simple: A small book you show to go to other countries.

items.example: My luggage is very heavy.
items.simple: The bags and boxes you take when you go away.

items.example: Our flight leaves at six.
items.simple: A ride in a plane from one place to another.

items.example: I booked a hotel online.
items.simple: You ask for a place or a seat, so it is yours.

items.en: I'd like to book a room for two nights.
items.tr: İki gecelik bir oda ayırtmak istiyorum.
items.example: I'd like to book a room for two nights.
items.exampleTr: İki gecelik bir oda ayırtmak istiyorum.
items.simple: You ask for a bed in a hotel for two nights.

items.example: We checked in at noon.
items.simple: You tell the hotel you are here and get your room.

items.example: We need to check out by eleven.
items.exampleTr: Saat on bire kadar çıkış yapmamız gerek.
items.simple: You tell the hotel you are going and give back your room key.

items.example: She works abroad.
items.simple: In a country that is not your home country.

items.example: The city is full of tourists.
items.simple: A person who comes to see a new place for fun.

items.example: There is a delay at the airport.
items.simple: Something comes late, not on time.

items.example: Our flight was delayed by two hours.
items.simple: The plane did not go at the right time. It went later.

items.example: We went sightseeing all day.
items.simple: You walk around a new place to look at nice things.

items.example: I bought a souvenir for my mum.
items.exampleTr: Annem için bir hediyelik eşya aldım.
items.simple: A small thing you buy to remember a place.

items.example: Have a nice trip! Send me a photo.
items.exampleTr: İyi yolculuklar! Bana bir fotoğraf at.
items.simple: You say a kind thing to a person who is going away.

items.example: Is breakfast included in the price?
items.simple: You ask if the morning food is in the price.

items.example: I haven’t packed yet.
items.simple: You put your things in a bag to go.

items.example: The plane takes off in ten minutes.
items.simple: The plane leaves the ground and goes up in the sky.

items.example: We set off at six in the morning.
items.simple: You start to go on a trip.

items.en: How long does it take to get there?
items.example: How long does it take to get there?
items.simple: You ask how much time you need to go there.
